100.description: Resting elevation — cards, banners, table rows, subtle containers (Tackle Design Library / Figma Elevation 100).

200.description: Hover / emphasis — buttons, interactive cards, menus (Figma Elevation 200).

300.description: Raised selection — selected rows or cards, further emphasis (Figma Elevation 300).

400.description: Overlays — modals, alerts, tooltips, dialogs (Figma Elevation 400).

500L.description: Directional depth — left panel / filter rail (Figma Elevation 500L).

500R.description: Directional depth — right drawer / panel (Figma Elevation 500R).
